{"consolidated_memory":"**Flapping Flags in platform/featureflags/eval.go: THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS**

All three incidents manifested the same symptom (decisions alternating between calls) in the same component, but had distinct root causes, affected populations, and fixes.

---

**INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-26] Floating Point Rounding in Money Path**
- File: platform/featureflags/eval.go
- Affected: clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Repro: evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Signal: decision alternates between calls
- Result: job finished in 83 minutes instead of 6 hours (8.65x improvement)
- Fix: moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #4832 on branch fix/flapping-flag-1
- Note: same corner of codebase as earlier flapping flag work

---

**INCIDENT 2: [2026-05-21] Mutable Default Argument**
- File: platform/featureflags/eval.go
- Affected: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Repro: evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Signal: decision alternates between calls
- Result: cold start improved 69 percent, down to 548 ms
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #5924 on branch fix/flapping-flag-2
- Note: same corner of codebase as earlier flapping flag work

---

**INCIDENT 3: [2026-06-12] Clock Skew Between Hosts**
- File: platform/featureflags/eval.go
- Affected: appeared only after rolling restart of the fleet
- Repro: evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Signal: decision alternates between calls
- Result: 60 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #8042 on branch fix/flapping-flag-3
- Stack: Go
- Test coverage: platform/featureflags/eval_test.go
- Note: same corner of codebase as earlier flapping flag work"}
